notes: Working name, not final (open question in docs/STATE.md). Never translate, transliterate or inflect; keep Latin script in ja/ko/zh-Hant.
Always capitalized. vi: 'gói Plus'. Never 'Pro', 'Premium' or 'Plus+'.

definition_en: Name of the free plan (the plan name, not the adjective).
notes: Proposed DNT so Free and Plus read as a pair (pricing doc uses 'gói Free'). The adjective 'free' (no cost) is translated: see bill_free_adj. PO to confirm per locale; ja/ko/zh-Hant/de translators may argue for a translated plan name.
Apple trademark. Never translate or pluralize.
Keep the space and capital OS.

definition_en: Microsoft's task app; a migration source.
notes: Product name has a space: 'To Do'.
Use Google's own localized product name per locale; do not coin one.
Used in email-forwarding setup guides.
Used in email-forwarding setup guides.
Apple trademark; keep as is in every locale.
Google trademark; keep as is.
Rendered by the system button (ASAuthorizationAppleIDButton), which localizes itself. Never draw or translate it. Same rule for the Google sign-in button.

definition_en: iOS feature showing live info on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
notes: Apple localizes this feature name. Copy the exact term from iOS Settings in each locale; vi value to verify on device.
ja: ライブアクティビティ

notes: Keep model names out of main UI (say 'Enhanced recognition'); if shown in details or licenses, never translate.

definition_en: Apple's built-in Reminders app (comparison/import copy only).
notes: Use Apple's localized app name exactly. Do not use this name for our own feature.

definition_en: Any entry in the app: task, event, appointment, booking or habit.
notes: Generic/internal. Prefer the specific word (task, appointment) in UI. vi 'mục', never the loanword 'item'. Count noun in plurals ('Found {count} items').

definition_en: Something to do, optionally with a due date and reminders.
notes: vi 'việc': short and neutral. Not 'nhiệm vụ' (sounds like an assigned mission) and not 'công việc' (that is the 'Work' list name, see list_work).

definition_en: Item with a start time, such as a meeting or birthday (kind=event).
notes: Counts toward the appointment limit in the Free plan.

definition_en: Repeating personal routine, such as drinking water (kind=habit).
notes: Default time mode is floating (follows the user's time zone).
Not the checklist inside one item (item_checklist).

definition_en: Default list for items that belong to no list.
notes: AMBIGUITY: UX doc names it 'Hộp thư', which collides with the email-forwarding mailbox and sits next to 'Hộp đề xuất'. Proposal: vi 'Chưa phân loại', en 'Inbox'. PO to decide before S1.

definition_en: Screen that holds items found by email forwarding or imports that the user has not reviewed.
notes: Named in i18n-l10n.md §8. en 'Suggestions', not 'Inbox' (clash with core_inbox).

definition_en: One unreviewed candidate item in Suggestions.
notes: vi 'đề xuất', not 'gợi ý' (gợi ý is used for UI hints such as 'Thêm hoạt động').

definition_en: Alert at a set time (or place) attached to an item.
notes: vi: 'nhắc' in counters, chips and buttons ('7/10 nhắc hôm nay', 'Thêm nhắc'); 'lời nhắc' allowed in full sentences and headings. Do not mix both on one screen.
vi 'kêu' is the docs' word ('Nhắc vẫn kêu đúng giờ'). en 'ring' or 'go off'; avoid 'fire' (developer word).

definition_en: Rule that makes an item happen again (daily, weekly, lunar...).
notes: 'Recurrence' is internal; UI says 'Repeat' like Apple/Google.
UX chip '🔁 Không lặp'. en option label 'Never' under the 'Repeat' label.

definition_en: All occurrences generated by one repeat rule.
notes: Do not show bare 'series' in en UI. Paywall says 'repeating reminders' / 'nhắc lặp lại' (key max_recurring_series).

definition_en: One instance of a repeating item.
notes: Never 'occurrence' in en UI: use 'this one'. vi 'lần' ('chỉ lần này').

vi: Lần này và các lần sau
definition_en: Edit/delete scope: this and following occurrences.
Repeat type: next one is N days after the last was done.
notes: Pair with ICU plural: '{days} days after done' / '{days} ngày sau khi xong'.

definition_en: Days that are neither weekend nor a public holiday in the chosen holiday country.
notes: Weekend comes from CLDR weekData (not always Sat-Sun).

definition_en: Postpone a reminder that has already rung.
notes: vi: UX/PRD use 'Hoãn'; iOS Clock in vi uses 'Báo lại'. Keep 'Hoãn' (short, matches docs) and test with users. de 'Schlummern' is the alarm term; translator may prefer 'Später erinnern' for reminders. fr: translator to check platform wording.

definition_en: Marks the item (or this occurrence) complete. Notification, list and watch action.
notes: vi 'Xong', not 'Hoàn thành' (too long for watch). ≤ 20 chars.

definition_en: Notification action: ring again in 10 minutes.
notes: Number and unit via ICU + duration formatter. Wireframe 'Hoãn 10'' uses a prime sign: do not ship it. ≤ 20 chars.

definition_en: Notification action: ring again in 1 hour.
notes: Wireframe 'Hoãn 1h': ship 'Hoãn 1 giờ'. ≤ 20 chars.

definition_en: Opens the item in the app.
Opens booking documents (QR, boarding pass) from a travel notification.
notes: From reminder-engine.md §6.

definition_en: Opens the maps app with a route to the venue.
notes: Match the wording of the platform maps app per locale.

definition_en: Second line of a repeating reminder notification.
notes: From reminder-engine.md §6. vi/ja/ko/zh-Hant/id have only the 'other' plural form.

definition_en: Alarm-style reminder that was not acted on rings again.
notes: Default 5 min, up to 3 times (UX §3.2).

definition_en: Loud reminder that repeats until acted on.

notes: de: iOS says 'Mitteilungen', Android 'Benachrichtigungen'; follow the platform the string ships on.

definition_en: App-level window when non-urgent reminders stay silent.
notes: Not the OS feature (Focus / Do Not Disturb, vi 'Không làm phiền'); never reuse OS feature names for it.

definition_en: Settings page with battery and exact-alarm checks.

vi: Gửi thông báo thử sau 1 phút
definition_en: Onboarding check that reminders ring on this phone.
notes: UX §3.1 step 5.

vi: Nhắc nhở có thể không kêu
definition_en: Warning when notification or exact-alarm permission is missing.
notes: UX §6b. Must be followed by one action that opens the right settings page.

definition_en: Android special access for exact alarms (SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM).
notes: Must match the label in Android Settings for each locale. Copy it from a real device; vi value unverified.

definition_en: Android power management that can delay or kill reminders.
notes: OEM labels differ (Xiaomi, Samsung, OPPO...). Guides quote the OEM's own label per locale, taken from screenshots.

definition_en: The current day in the user's current time zone.
notes: Tab name and section header.

es 'mañana' = tomorrow AND morning; never use bare 'mañana' for morning in chips. de 'morgen' (tomorrow) vs 'Morgen' (morning). pt-BR 'amanhã' vs 'manhã'. vi chips may shorten to 'Mai'; NLU accepts 'mai', 'sáng mai'.
vi regional: North 'ngày kia', South 'ngày mốt'. UI uses 'ngày kia'; NLU accepts both. North 'ngày kìa' = 3 days out: NLU must confirm with a chip.

definition_en: Past its due time and not done.
notes: Neutral tone: state, not blame.

definition_en: Next 3 days on Today; future trips on Trips.
Items dated today without a time.
notes: UX wireframe says 'KHÔNG GIỜ', which a vi reader can parse as 'không giờ' = 0:00 (midnight). Ship 'Chưa đặt giờ'. Proposed.

definition_en: Item with a date but no time; stored as date without time zone.
Date/time an item should be done by.
notes: vi 'Hạn: {date}'; state label 'Đến hạn'. No 'deadline' loanword in vi UI.

definition_en: IANA time zone of an item or the user.
notes: Show city/region names from CLDR (e.g. 'Hanoi time'), never raw IANA ids or 'GMT+7' alone.

definition_en: User's home time zone; used for daily limits and new items.
notes: Internal name home_tz. vi 'múi giờ nhà' sounds odd: use 'chính'.

definition_en: Time at the place where an event happens.
notes: Pair with the place: '10:30 Hanoi time · 04:30 London time' (i18n-l10n.md §6).

definition_en: Time mode 'floating': rings at the same clock time wherever the user is.
notes: Never show the word 'floating' to users.

vi: Cố định theo múi giờ sự kiện
definition_en: Time mode 'fixed': tied to the event's time zone.

notes: Vietnam has no DST; explain in a short note when shown. en-GB users say 'summer time'.
vi day parts for NLU defaults: sáng ~05-10, trưa ~11-13, chiều ~13-18, tối ~18-22, đêm ~22-04. UI shows times via CLDR, not day-part words.
vi '12 giờ trưa' = 12:00.
vi '3 giờ chiều' = 15:00.
vi '8 giờ tối' = 20:00.
vi '12 giờ đêm' is ambiguous (start or end of the day): NLU shows a chip.
vi: avoid regional 'chừ', 'giờ' alone in UI.
Always from the ICU relative-time formatter, never concatenated. Example in i18n-l10n.md §4.
Week start comes from CLDR (Sunday in US, Monday in VN/EU).
vi 'tuần sau' and 'tuần tới' both fine; UI uses 'tuần sau'.

definition_en: First day of week; default from CLDR.

notes: vi 'lịch' also means 'schedule'; context makes it clear.
vi 'dương lịch' in UI, not 'lịch Gregory'.

definition_en: Lunisolar calendar used in VN, CN, KR and others.
notes: Variants use different time zones (UTC+7/+8/+9) and can differ by one day. vi abbreviation 'ÂL' (Today header).
Label variants by country in settings only.
zh-Hant users say '農曆'; do not label it in a way that implies VN/KR dates are 'Chinese'.
Dates can differ by ±1 day from local announcements (Ramadan, Eid): copy must say so.

definition_en: Extra month in a lunisolar year.
notes: Options: skip / both / first only (data-model).
en has no single word: use the long form in settings, 'full moon day' in chips.

definition_en: First day of a lunar month.
notes: vi spelling 'mùng 1' (docs); 'mồng 1' also correct but do not mix.

definition_en: Yearly remembrance on the lunar date of a relative's death.
notes: Respectful tone; no emoji, no jokes, no upsell copy next to it.

definition_en: New year of the lunisolar calendar.
notes: en: 'Lunar New Year', not 'Chinese New Year'. Promo copy per market (Tết / Seollal / 春節).

definition_en: Optional extra calendar shown under Gregorian dates.
Official holidays of the chosen country.
Country whose holidays and weekend are used.
notes: Docs say 'quốc gia ngày lễ'; UI wording proposed.

definition_en: Weekend days per CLDR for the holiday country.
notes: Fri-Sat in some Middle East markets.

definition_en: Bottom sheet to type or speak a new item.
notes: Named feature: en title case allowed here only.

definition_en: Live text of what speech recognition heard.
notes: vi: not 'bản ghi âm' (implies audio is stored; it is not).

definition_en: Opens the camera to capture a ticket or document.
notes: UX shows 'Chụp' in a tight row; full label for screen readers.

definition_en: Pick an image from the gallery.
Pick a PDF, xlsx, csv or md file.
notes: vi: iOS says 'Tệp' (Files app); UX wireframe says 'File'. Proposed 'Tệp' for consistency with the OS; LQA confirm.

definition_en: Bring items in from a photo, file, email or another app.
notes: vi AMBIGUITY: 'nhập' also means 'type in' (nhập tay). Always give an object: 'Nhập từ ảnh', 'Nhập từ Microsoft To Do'. Docs use the loanword 'Import'; UI should not.

en: Enter manually with photo as reference
vi: Nhập tay với ảnh làm tham chiếu
definition_en: Form with the source image on top; tap OCR text to fill fields.
notes: UX §2.4. May wrap to 2 lines.

definition_en: Screen where the user checks extracted items before saving.
notes: vi: not 'Duyệt' (sounds like approval workflow).

definition_en: Field the reader is unsure about (highlighted).
notes: Never 'Error' / 'Lỗi': the field may be right.

definition_en: Marks fields filled by the OS on-device model.
notes: Keep 'AI' in Latin script. Never imply cloud processing.

en: Processed on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
vi: Xử lý trên máy, không gửi lên mạng
definition_en: Privacy note on the reading screen.
notes: The claim must stay literally true. Do not strengthen it ('100% secure', 'an toàn tuyệt đối').
Use the ellipsis character …, not three dots.

definition_en: Saves all selected candidates on Review.
Picker to attach bookings to a trip.
notes: UX shows 'Gộp vào: [Chuyến Hà Nội ▾]'.

en: Send redacted sample to help improve
vi: Gửi mẫu để cải thiện (đã che thông tin cá nhân)
definition_en: Sends a redacted copy of a document layout.
notes: Must mention redaction; a preview of the redacted copy is shown first.

definition_en: Forward booking emails to a personal address.

notes: Never translate or reformat the address. Wrap in bidi isolate for RTL.

definition_en: Group of bookings and plans for one journey.
notes: Tab label plural in en ('Trips'), vi 'Chuyến đi'.

definition_en: One leg or stay inside a trip.
notes: Internal word; UI usually shows the booking itself.

definition_en: Reservation: flight, train, bus, hotel, car rental, ferry, tour...
notes: vi: avoid loanword 'booking' in UI (NLU accepts it). Use 'vé' when it is a ticket.

definition_en: PNR / confirmation number, usually 6 letters or digits.
notes: The code itself: never translate, never change case, monospace, bidi isolate. Compact form 'Mã: ABC123'.
Only in help/FAQ; UI says 'booking code'.
es: 'billete' (ES) vs 'boleto' (LatAm); pt-BR 'passagem' (air) vs 'bilhete'. Translator decides per variant.

definition_en: Document that lets a passenger board.
notes: vi: Vietnam Airlines writes 'thẻ lên tàu bay'; UI uses 'thẻ lên máy bay'; extractor accepts both plus 'boarding pass'. es: ES 'tarjeta de embarque', MX 'pase de abordar'.
The number itself is never translated.
de: 'Abflug' (flight) vs 'Abfahrt' (train/bus): separate keys per booking type, or a select.
vi 'Đến' alone is vague in labels: 'Giờ đến' for time, 'Nơi đến' for place.
vi airports show 'Cửa 12'; en example 'Gate 12' (reminder-engine.md §6).
vi 'Nhà ga T1' (UX §3.2). zh-Hant: TW '航廈', HK '客運大樓'.
VN trains: 'Chỗ' or 'Giường' for sleeper berths; use the word printed on the ticket type.

definition_en: Airline check-in, online or at the counter.
notes: Different word from hotel check-in in many locales (zh-Hant 報到 vs 入住, fr enregistrement vs arrivée, vi 'làm thủ tục' vs 'nhận phòng'). Keep separate keys.
See trip_checkin_flight.
vi 'tàu' alone also means ship; use 'tàu hỏa' where context is unclear.
en label: 'Car {number}' (US) or 'Coach {number}' (UK); en-GB LQA decides.
VN tickets rarely show it; EU tickets do (de 'Gleis 7'). vi translator to confirm wording.
vi 'xe khách' (intercity), not 'xe buýt' (city bus).
vi: 'tàu cao tốc' for fast boats; translator picks by ticket type.
Sensitive data: never in logs or analytics.

definition_en: Checklist of things to bring on a trip.
notes: UX says 'Checklist hành lý'; proposed full vi term.

definition_en: Trip tab with original files and QR codes.

notes: Keep 'QR' in Latin.
vi: since 1 Jul 2024 the card is 'thẻ căn cước' (was CCCD); extractor still accepts CMND/CCCD. Sensitive: mask numbers.
Sensitive: mask numbers.
en-GB may prefer 'stopover'.

definition_en: Suggestion shown in gaps > 3h on the trip timeline.

notes: Paywall limit 'appointments' (max_active_appointments) also counts events and bookings: help text must say 'events, appointments and bookings'. vi 'lịch hẹn' generic; 'lịch khám' when medical.
Health data (sensitive).

Number printed on hospital slips (VN, JP...).
notes: Market-specific field.
Never phrase as medical advice; we only repeat what the slip says.

definition_en: Default checklist line before an appointment.

notes: en sample 'Take blood pressure pill' (reminder-engine.md §6).
vi: 'thẻ BHYT' allowed in checklists. Market-specific.
Not the plan name (plan_free).

definition_en: Store-managed trial period before the first charge.
notes: pt-BR: Apple uses 'avaliação gratuita'; translator confirms.
Trial length comes from the store product, not a literal.
Always show '3 months'; 'quarterly' is less clear to many users.
{price} is the store-localized string (or a CLDR currency format of the store amount). Never build it from a number and a symbol.

definition_en: Actual charge under a per-month equivalent.
notes: Required whenever a per-month equivalent is shown.

definition_en: Opens the paywall or confirms purchase.
Re-applies an existing store purchase on this account.
notes: Required by both stores. vi from pricing doc.

vi: Hủy bất cứ lúc nào trong phần cài đặt của {store}
definition_en: How to cancel, shown on the paywall.
notes: {store} = App Store / Google Play (DNT). Must be accurate.
Required disclosure.
No blame, no threats; reminders keep ringing (pricing §3).
Only for entitlement keys with value -1. Plus still limits PDF pages per import and cloud storage: never say 'unlimited everything'.
Copy points to the store's refund page.
Apple says 'offer code', Google 'promo code'.
Legal text: local lawyer reviews.

notes: Legal text: local lawyer reviews.

definition_en: User's explicit permission for a data use.
Secondary button on permission priming screens.
notes: Never confirmshaming ('No, I like missing things').

vi: nhận dạng giọng nói trực tuyến
definition_en: Apple/Google cloud STT, used only with consent when no on-device engine exists.

notes: Destructive: confirmation states what is deleted and that the store subscription must be cancelled separately.

es: iOS 'Ajustes', Android 'Configuración'; pt-BR iOS 'Ajustes', Android 'Configurações'; fr iOS 'Réglages', Android 'Paramètres'. Follow the platform.

definition_en: App language, region format, voice language, holiday country, secondary calendar.
Language of the UI, notifications, widgets, watch.
Language/variant for speech recognition; can differ from app language.
Extra languages the text parser accepts.

notes: vi: 'Giao diện' already means UI in 'Ngôn ngữ giao diện'; use 'Hiển thị' for this section. Proposed.
vi: accepted loanword ('Đang offline' in UX §6b); not 'ngoại tuyến' in banners.

Adds the item to the device calendar (EventKit / CalendarContract).
notes: vi 'lịch máy' = the phone's calendar app.
Proposed vi term.

definition_en: Tab with lists, Suggestions, integrations, plan, settings.
notes: en alternatives 'You', 'Profile': test in prototype.
≤ 30 chars on watch (i18n-l10n.md §7).
Use Apple's localized term from watchOS per locale; vi to verify on device. Do not coin a term.
Use Google's localized term from Wear OS per locale; vi to verify.
iOS and Android vi both say 'tiện ích'.
Microsoft To Do calls them 'steps' (import mapping).
vi 'thẻ' follows Apple Reminders but also means 'card'; never call BookingCard a 'thẻ' in UI copy next to tags.

notes: Date via formatter: 'Từ email Vietjet · {date}'.
Items over the Free limit after import go to Archive (archived_reason=quota): say so plainly.
vi 'Hủy' also reads as cancelling a booking/subscription. In dialogs about bookings or plans, use 'Đóng' or 'Không' instead.
